items.title: Component disabled
items.summary: You can disable some functions on the page by setting the Frontmatter of the page.
items.content_html:
You can disable some functions on the page by setting the Frontmatter of the page.

These should be disabled on this page:

  • Navbar
  • Sidebar
  • Breadcrumb
  • Page information
  • Contributors
  • Edit link
  • Update time
  • Prev/Next link
  • Comment
  • Footer
  • Back to top button

items.title: Markdown Enhance
items.summary: vuepress-theme-hope enables more syntax in Markdown via the built-in md-enhance plugin.
items.content_html:
vuepress-theme-hope enables more syntax in Markdown via the built-in md-enhance plugin.

Enable all

You can set themeconfig.mdEnhance.enableAll to enable all features of the md-enhance plugin.

module.exports = {
  themeConfig: {
    mdEnhance: {
      enableAll: true,
    },
  },
};

items.summary: Page information You can set page information in Markdown’s Frontmatter. The author is set to Ms.Hope. The writing time should be January 1, 2020 Category is "Guide" Tags are "P...
items.content_html:
Page information

You can set page information in Markdown’s Frontmatter.

  • The author is set to Ms.Hope.

  • The writing time should be January 1, 2020

  • Category is "Guide"

  • Tags are "Page Config" and "Guide"

Page content

You are free to write your Markdown here.

Tips

  • Please use the relative link ./ for pictures in the Markdown folder.

  • For pictures in .vuepress/public folder, please use absolute link / for reference

The theme contains a custom badge:

A dark blue badge text badge at the end of line.

Page structure

This page should contain:

  • Back to top button
  • Route navigation
  • Comments
  • Footer
